p: way of the spies: By that way which their spies, that searched the dangers found to he most safe.
compass the land of Edom: For they were forbidden to destroy it, De 2:5.
bread: Meaning manna, which they thought did not nourish.
fiery serpents among the people: For they that were bitten by them were so inflamed by the poison of them, that they died.
book of the wars of the: Which seems to be the book of the Judges, or as some think, a book which is lost.
sing ye unto it: You that receive the convenience of it, give praise for it.
lawgiver: Only Moses and Aaron, the heads of the people, struck the rock with the rod or staff, which gave water as a well that was deep digged.
strong: For the people were tall and strong like giants; De 2:20.
Heshbon was the city of Sihon: For if it had been the Moabites, the Israelites might not have possessed it, De 2:9.
fire gone out of Heshbon: Meaning, wane.
Chemosh: Chemosh was the idol of the Moabites, 1Ki 11:33 who was not able to defend his worshippers, who took the idol for their father.
